comment: Both trigger inputs are pushed through rescale(v, 0.1f, 2.0f, 0.f, 1.f) before a SchmittTrigger whose thresholds are left at Rack's defaults, so the real thresholds are 2V rising and 0.1V falling rather than the 1V/0.1V a reader would expect from a Rack module. The output is written only on a transition, so it holds its last value across a sample-rate change. No port reads getChannels or getPolyVoltage anywhere in the plugin, so nothing here is polyphonic.
